title: Rational geometric preservation on the fixed-size constant-model hull
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite continuous extension of Q_ell or the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure Lambda, and a field k of prime characteristic different from ell. Let g:Z -> Y be proper between separated finite-type k-schemes. Form the ordinary localizing hulls of constantModelBoundedConstructible using coproduct indices in universe u+1. Suppose h states that ambient Rg_* preserves these hulls, and let G be any right adjoint of precisely its full-subcategory lift. For every bounded constant-model constructible K on Y and integer n, H^n(G(K)) has finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification. No integral coefficient is covered by this statement.

proof.text: Embed a finite continuous coefficient field E into the fixed algebraic closure using IsAlgClosed.lift. Its fieldRange is finite dimensional, and equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearEquiv gives the continuous algebra isomorphism. Postcomposition and ULift.ringEquiv give the actual condensed ring isomorphism. The algebraic-closure case retains padicAlgClRingObj and uses its identity isomorphism.

Apply localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc with this coefficient isomorphism. The finite-Tor generators equal bounded constant-model constructible objects. localizingClosure_exists gives coproducts and repleteness. maps_localizingClosureProEtale applied to the identity gives the large-to-small inclusion; lift small index types to obtain the reverse inclusion. Thus hull_eq identifies the fixed u+1 hull with localizingClosureProEtale.

Choose Compactification.ofIsProper for g. Its open part is the identity and is quasi-compact, so this is a boundary compactification. The adjunction for extension by zero along the identity and upperStarId identifies that functor with the identity. Its derived isomorphism identifies the actual compact-support composite with ambient Rg_*. Transfer the supplied preservation and adjunction through the full hull inclusions using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful.

Apply rationalRestrictionGlue to this compactification and this transported supplied adjunction, with the same finite-intermediate-field or finite-subextension-valued coefficient isomorphism. Its hG conclusion gives bounded constant-model constructibility of G(K); take the cohomology component in each degree. No new right adjoint or coefficient data is selected from an unproved mere existence statement.

    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {Z Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom] [IsSeparated Z.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper g.left]
    (hΛ : IsRationalEllAdicCoefficient ℓ Λ inferInstance)
    (h : ∀ K, localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1} (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Z.left) K →
      localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1} (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y.left)
        ((R((g.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)).obj K))
    (G : (localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1}
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1}
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Z.left)).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : (localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1}
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y.left)).lift
      ((localizingClosureOfSize.{u + 1}
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Z.left)).ι ⋙ R((g.left)_*⟦Λ⟧))
      (fun K ↦ h K.obj K.property) ⊣ G)
    (K : (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Z.left
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        (G.obj ((ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (constantModel_le_localizingClosure Λ Y.left)).obj
          K)).obj)
